title: Commercial APM: Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace and Sentry

videos.script: Everything in this course so far runs on one machine you control. Prometheus, Loki, Jaeger, Grafana. About twenty containers, and somebody has to keep them alive. {{stack}} The other way is to pay somebody to keep them alive. That is what Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace and Sentry sell. {{vendors}} This lesson does not log into any of them. It does something more useful. It looks at what crosses the wire. First, an error tracker's SDK reporting a real exception. And quietly sending a card number with it. {{sdk}} Then the Collector sending every trace to a hosted intake as well as to Jaeger, with nothing changed in the services. {{fanout}} And then the bill. What each product counts, and how a team gets surprised by it. {{bill}}
